title: Evidence retrieval for polar precursor hypothesis

source.title: WSO Polar Field Observations - 1976-Present
source.key_claim: Provides polar-field observations and low-pass filtered values suitable for precursor-style diagnostics.
source.design_role: Primary data source for H1 polar precursor and low-order toy model.
source.limitation: Only a few complete WSO-to-next-cycle pairs are available for long-cycle validation.

source.title: The Topology of the Sun's Magnetic Field and the 22-Year Cycle
source.key_claim: The solar magnetic cycle can be explained through magnetic-field topology and polarity reversal processes.
source.design_role: Foundational support for Babcock-Leighton style precursor and poloidal-to-toroidal narrative.
source.limitation: Foundational conceptual model, not a modern data pipeline.

source.title: Solar cycle prediction
source.key_claim: Solar-cycle prediction methods can be grouped into precursor, model-based, and extrapolation approaches; polar-field precursors have performed well in recent cycles.
source.design_role: Supports H1 framing and the claim boundary separating precursor constraints from operational forecasts.
source.limitation: Review taxonomy does not provide enough data for Cycle 26 by itself.

source.title: Dynamo models of the solar cycle
source.key_claim: Solar-cycle modeling is a hydromagnetic dynamo problem with observational constraints and multiple regeneration mechanisms.
source.design_role: Supports Babcock-Leighton mechanism language, H5 toy closure, and observation-model comparison.
source.limitation: A contest toy model is only a surrogate and not a full MHD dynamo.

links.claim: Cycle-26 confidence should be governed by polar-field precursor evidence, not by sunspot/F10.7 proxies alone.
counter_evidence: Only four complete WSO precursor pairs are available in the current pipeline.
Cycle 25/26 minimum-time polar field is not mature enough for a direct Cycle-26 amplitude forecast.
next_validation: Extend polar precursor evidence using NSO/SOLIS or polar faculae proxies.
Run leave-one-cycle-out tests after adding earlier polar-field proxies.

verification_points: 证据检索返回 WSO、Babcock、Petrovay、Charbonneau 等与 H1 直接相关的来源。
H1 证据链同时包含支持来源、反证/限制和下一步验证计划。
该案例证明文献层不是静态参考文献列表，而是可被 API 查询的结构化证据矩阵。
